about_the_game:
For players looking to take their support for Coridden to the next level, the Supporter Pack offers a variety of in-game cosmetic items:

Includes:

  • Color Picker - Personalize your character glow with a range of vibrant colors.

  • Droke Pet Companion – A faithful and charming companion to accompany you on your adventure.

  • Gold Coating – Shine bright with this one-of-a-kind golden armor effect.

  • "The Benevolent" Footprint Effect – Make each step show the world your generous soul.

  • "Titan Steps" Footprint Effect - Shatter the ground beneath you with every step you take.

All the cosmetics can be accessed from the Cosmetics Menu inside the Dayal House in Quilon.

Thank you for your incredible support!

name: Coridden - Supporter Pack

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD FX-8320 (3.5 GHz) / Intel i5-4690K (3.5 GHz)
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3930K (3.2 GHz)/AMD Ryzen 5 1600 (3.2 GHz) or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: For players who want to go above and beyond in supporting the developers of Coridden, this Supporter Pack offers a selection of unique in-game items.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese
